Atooi Collection.name: atooi Collection
Atooi Collection.summary:
Atooi Collection was Limited Run Games' 001 release on Nintendo 3DS, which went live August 7, 2020.
Only 6000 copies were made with 2000 sold as part of the Collector's Edition.
The collection is region-locked to North American versions of the Nintendo 3DS.

A single cartridge features the following critically-acclaimed games: Mutant Mudds Deluxe, Bomb Monkey, Xeodrifter, Mutant Mudds Super Challenge, and Chicken Wiggle.

Imagine - Babies 3D.name: Imagine: Babies 3D
Imagine - Babies 3D.summary: Imagine is introducing a 3D baby simulation game where players can interact with the most true-to-life babies yet. As a babysitter, players travel the world caring for babies and helping them grow, keeping both the babies and their parents happy in order to build their reputation and ultimately open their own dream day care business. Experience the life of a successful babysitter with incredibly lifelike 3D visuals, animations and baby reactions!

LEGO Marvel Vengadores.name: LEGO Marvel's Avengers
LEGO Marvel Vengadores.summary: Lego Marvel's Avengers is a Lego-themed action-adventure video game developed by Traveller's Tales and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment. It is the spin-off to Lego Marvel Super Heroes and the second instalment of the Lego Marvel franchise. The game is based on the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

Nintendogs + Cats - Golden Retriever & N.name: Nintendogs + Cats: Golden Retriever & New Friends
Nintendogs + Cats - Golden Retriever & N.summary: nintendogs + cats, a game that lets players interact with realistic puppies - and kittens - in a variety of fun ways. There are three versions of the software, each with different starting breeds: French bulldog, toy poodle and golden retriever. But in each version players can unlock and enjoy more than 20 different breeds.

Toushin Toshi - Girls Gift RPG.name: Toushin Toshi Girls Gift RPG
Toushin Toshi - Girls Gift RPG.summary: A reimagining of Toushin Toshi 2. It features a new version of the original story, coupled with a completely new battle system and dungeon designs.
